event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 78 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 29.92 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,712 feet, track temperature 107 degrees.

Austin Prock is 2 - 5 in Rd. 1 this year. Dave Richards is 2 - 6 in Rd. 1 this year.

This is the first time Prock and Richards have faced each other in eliminations. 

Prock with the starting linne advantage and the holds on for the win.  He was dropping cylinder in the lights
for the win.  He still makes his quickest pass of the weekend.

Richards makes his quickest pass in the losing effort.

Spence Hyde is 14 - 13 in Rd. 1. Cruz Pedregon is 0 - 3 in Rd. 1 at this race when qualified #11

Hyde is 1 - 0 against Pedregon in prior events. 

Pedregon with problems after the burnout and the car is shut off.

Hyde is straight down the groove hooked up to make the quickest pass of the event.

Jack Beckman has won back-to-back races 3 times in his career. Jeff Arend is #12 and the #12 FC qualifier is 9
- 15 in Rd. 1 here.

Beckman is 20 - 5 against Arend in prior events. 

Arend with the starting line advantage, but started to drop cylinders AND SHUT IT OFF EARLY.

Beckman is strtaight down the groove for the win.

Matt Hagan is 48 - 6 in Rd. 1 when qualified #1. Jon Capps is making his 11th start.

Hagan is 2 - 0 against Capps in prior events. 

Capps goes red to give Hagan the win.

Hagan is straight down the groove with a good clean pass.  He will have a bye in the next round.

This (#2) is the best starting spot for Alexis since this race last year. Jordan Vandergriff qualified #13 and
the #13 FC qualifier is 6 - 18 in Rd. 1 at this event.

Vandergriff is 1 - 0 against DeJoria in prior events. 

Vandergriff with the starting line advantage and kept it hooked up, hitting on all eight to make the quickest
pass of the event for the win.

Daniel Wilkerson is 0 - 3 against Todd this year.  J.R. Todd has never won a race from the #9 spot.

Todd is 4 - 2 against Wilkerson in prior events. 

They leave together, but Todd starts to smoke the tires and clicked it off.

Wilkerson kept it hooked up and was straight down the groove for the win.  He will give up lane choice to
Beckman in the next round.

Ron Capps wins 74% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice. Chad Green is 2 - 4 against Capps in Rd.1

Capps is 7 - 5 against Green in prior events. 

Green with the starting line advantage, but Capps had the difference made up by the time they go by the
Christmas tree and never trailed from there on for the win.  Capps launched hard and kept it hooked up to make
the quickest pass of the event for win and lane choice over Vandergriff in the next round by  0.010 seconds.

Green started dropping cylinders on the top end in the losing effort.
